title: Kissed by the sun Australian chicken stir-fry
description: A cultured and chewy Australian dish, featuring yellow pepper, perfect for a romantic evening with loved ones. The low-fat-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a claypot.
instructions: Heat the claypot over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Add the chicken breast and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Add the sliced onion, minced garlic, and diced yellow pepper to the claypot.
Cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sliced zucchini, chicken stock, honey, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the claypot.
Stir well to combine and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or basil if desired.
